pack:
## Who they are
Segway (Segway-Ninebot) makes e-scooters. We make TikTok videos for Segway Germany, filmed in Berlin. German is the master language: German audio and German burned-in captions. Batch 2 was shot by the Berlin production partner SOM (Jul to Aug 2026).

## People
- Mavis Chen (Segway-Ninebot marketing): our contact. She passes on notes from the Segway Germany team, mostly as short Frame.io and Slack notes. Treat every short note as binding.
- Our lead: Atdhe.

## North star: authentic proof
Show the scooter earning its keep in real Berlin conditions, shown not claimed. Atdhe (19 Jun 2026): "more authenticity, more real, more genuine… THAT is what Gen-Z wants." Segway's marketing team called Batch 1 "too staged" and its music "childish" and "unnatural".

## Hard rules
- No staged skit or acting as the lead. Simple and believable beats production value.
- No speed: no speedometer, no speed readout, no top-speed claim anywhere. German law caps e-scooters at 20 km/h. Sell the punch off the line, never the number.
- Hook first on short-form: open cold on the hook bite or a hook text of six words or fewer. No logo sting, no speaker lower third, no slow push-in before the hook. Logo or end card only at the very end.
- Music restrained and modern. No novelty or comedy stings.
- No drone, no night shoots, no office interiors, no transit property. Berlin only.
- Brand font not on file (asked from Mavis): a clean neutral sans until it arrives, no novelty type.
- Compliance beats craft: when the Germany team raises a legality question, the cut waits for their answer.

## Standing notes from the client
- Model names follow the German catalogue: Germany has D models (for example GT3 D, not GT3 Pro; F3 D). Say and write the D. Check against segway.com before sending.
- Every number must match between voice and on-screen text.
- Post captions carry no #ridebetter hashtag.
- The Germany side checks German copy closely. Past fixes: "FAHREN, WIE MIT DEM RAD" (not "SIE"), "FAHRER" (not "FAHRRAD"), "BREITES DECK, GROSSE RAEDER", "SIND FUER MEINEN SCOOTER".
- Script 4: the end super must read "commute", not "Kommut".

## Script 12, Walk or Segway (this cut)
- The script was written for three people and a car; SOM shot two people and no car. Never build a driver, a third panel or a parking joke.
- The train-station (underpass) question from the Germany team is about Script 15, not Script 12.
- Mavis, 27 Oct 2026: "I suggest blurring the face of the person in the middle - other than that, you can just keep it as is."
- Mavis on V2, 3 Nov 2026: at 0:12 "Let's remove the shot with the scooter, since you can't ride one with just one hand." At 0:16 "Delete the above and keep only the one below."

## Spellings
Segway, Ninebot, Segway-Ninebot (never "segue"). Models: E3, F3, Max G3, GT3 Pro, ZT3 Pro, and the German D models.

## Brand
- No colours or logo file in the client file. The Segway Germany site (de-de.segway.com) uses red #F30000, near-black #0F0F0F, dark red #C40001 and grey #86868B, and the font MiSans.
